releaseNotes:
1. Web-to-App Sync: Easily create vocabulary lists on our new website (https://mypolylearnlanguages.com) and use the new Bulk Import feature to scan the generated QR code!
2. Topic Management: Added a highly requested

option to clean up your lists instantly.
3. Better Trial Limits: Increased the maximum number of words allowed per topic for trial users so you can explore more before upgrading.
4. UI refinements for a smoother experience.
